page.overview:
Who is Hit & Run?

Hit and Run are minor characters and racers from Thunder Hollow in Cars 3.

In Cars 3, Hit and Run are two of the competitors who oppose Lightning McQueen and Cruz Ramírez when they accidentally enter a derby. Both are eliminated from the competition when they both slam into Miss Fritter making her angry and smash into them, with Ramirez emerging victorious.

In Cars: on the Road, episode 4:The Legend, one of them dies getting crushed by Ivy in her flashback.
